services.desc: Our birthday package is $300+tax for 10 kids. Each kid beyond 10 is an additional $30+tax Our maximum number for now is 16 kids. If you find that you don’t have 10 for a party, we can take smaller groups (no more than 8) in our open studio at $30+tax

services.name: Summer Camp 2026

Camp will focus on two broad creative areas: Within these categories, kids will have the freedom to explore a variety of materials, techniques, and projects.
